title: End of session
summary: Remove the slide, park the optics, and leave the microscope clean and documented. Placeholder content written from general laboratory practice, not from the manufacturer's manual.

steps.title: Park the objective and lower the stage
steps.body: Watch the clearance from the side and rotate the lowest-power objective into place, lowering the stage first if needed for clearance. Lower the stage to its loading position and stop any remaining image acquisition.
steps.check: The lowest-power objective is selected and there is clear space to remove the slide.

steps.title: Remove the slide and clean the stage
steps.body: Release the slide holder and lift the slide out by its edges before putting it in its labeled container. Remove debris from the stage and base using the laboratory-approved cleaning method, keeping liquid away from openings.

steps.title: Clean the optics and extinguish illumination
steps.body: Inspect exposed optics and clean only where needed using approved lens tissue and the laboratory optical-cleaning method. Reduce brightness and switch off illumination, then leave the microscope in its designated parked configuration.

steps.title: Record the session
steps.body: Record the sample identifier, objectives used, and saved image location in the logbook. Note any contamination, focus problems, or damaged parts so the next user knows what needs attention.
